name: rhetorix
description: Extension Chromium MV3 d'analyse rhétorique d'articles par LLM

scripts.package:chrome: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist/chrome -a artifacts -n rhetorix-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a artifacts -n rhetorix-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && git archive --format=zip --output=artifacts/rhetorix-sources.zip HEAD
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
